questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: The maximum speed with which a car can safely take a circular turn of radius r on a level unbanked road, with coefficient of friction μ, is:
questions.explanation: Friction supplies the centripetal force, so μmg = mv²/r gives v(max) = √(μrg). Banking the road allows a higher safe speed.
questions.ncertReference: Physics Class 11, Chapter 4: Laws of Motion

questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: Bernoulli's theorem for the steady flow of an ideal fluid is an application of the conservation of:
questions.explanation: The theorem states that pressure energy, kinetic energy and potential energy per unit volume add to a constant along a streamline. The equation of continuity is the one based on conservation of mass.
questions.ncertReference: Physics Class 11, Chapter 9: Mechanical Properties of Fluids

questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: When a p-n junction diode is forward biased, the width of the depletion region:
questions.explanation: Forward bias opposes the built-in potential barrier, so the depletion layer narrows and a large current flows. Reverse bias widens it instead.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: Water has a far higher boiling point than hydrogen sulphide mainly because of:
questions.explanation: Oxygen is small and highly electronegative, so water molecules form strong hydrogen bonds. Sulphur is much less electronegative, so H₂S is a gas at room temperature despite its greater mass.
questions.ncertReference: Chemistry Class 11, Chapter 4: Chemical Bonding and Molecular Structure

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: According to Henry's law, the solubility of a gas in a liquid at a fixed pressure:
questions.explanation: Dissolution of a gas is exothermic, so the Henry constant K(H) rises with temperature and solubility falls. This is why aquatic life suffers in warm water.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: Heating an alkyl halide with sodium metal in dry ether to obtain a symmetrical alkane is known as the:
questions.explanation: In the Wurtz reaction 2R-X + 2Na gives R-R, so it always produces an alkane with an even number of carbon atoms when a single halide is used.
questions.ncertReference: Chemistry Class 12, Chapter 6: Haloalkanes and Haloarenes

questions.subject: Botany
questions.question: Photorespiration occurs in C₃ plants but not in C₄ plants because in C₄ plants:
options: CO₂ concentration at the site of RuBisCO is kept high in bundle sheath cells
The Calvin cycle does not operate
questions.explanation: RuBisCO binds O₂ when CO₂ is scarce. The C₄ pathway pumps CO₂ into bundle sheath cells, so the enzyme always sees plenty of CO₂ and acts only as a carboxylase.
questions.ncertReference: Biology Class 11, Chapter 11: Photosynthesis in Higher Plants

questions.subject: Botany
questions.question: The thermostable enzyme used in the polymerase chain reaction is:
questions.explanation: Taq polymerase comes from the thermophilic bacterium Thermus aquaticus and survives the high denaturation temperature of each PCR cycle.
questions.ncertReference: Biology Class 12, Chapter 9: Biotechnology: Principles and Processes

questions.subject: Zoology
questions.question: The oxygen dissociation curve of haemoglobin shifts to the right when:
options: pCO₂ rises, pH falls and temperature increases
Oxygen partial pressure rises in the alveoli
questions.explanation: This is the Bohr effect. In active tissues higher CO₂, lower pH and higher temperature lower haemoglobin's affinity, so more oxygen is unloaded exactly where it is needed.
questions.ncertReference: Biology Class 11, Chapter 14: Breathing and Exchange of Gases

questions.subject: Zoology
questions.question: The wings of a butterfly and the wings of a bird are analogous organs, which indicates:
questions.explanation: Analogous organs differ in structure and origin but serve the same function, showing that unrelated groups evolved similar adaptations under similar pressures.
